agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on Wednesday June 24, 2026 in Built Heritage Committee Report 32.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Monday, June 8th, 2026, and the deadline to register by email to speak is 8:30 am on Tuesday June 9th, 2026.
agenda_items.minutes: These “Summary Minutes” indicate the disposition of items and actions taken at the meeting. This document does not include all of the text that will be included in the full Minutes, such as the record of written and oral submissions. Recorded votes and dissents contained in the Summary Minutes are draft until the full Minutes of the meeting are confirmed by the Committee. The draft of the full Minutes (for confirmation) will be published with the agenda for the next regular Committee meeting and, once confirmed, will replace this document.

sub_agendas_items.title: Designation of 575 Island Park Crescent under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act

motions.motion_text:
WHEREAS a demolition permit application under the Ontario Building Code Act and an application under the Demolition Control By-law have been submitted for the property at 575 Island Park Crescent; and
WHEREAS the City's Official Plan directs the immediate review and consideration of properties for designation that are threatened with demolition; and
WHEREAS staff have evaluated the property at 575 Island Park Crescent against Ontario Regulation 09/06 and determined that it meets four of the nine criteria and merits protection through designation under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act; and
WHEREAS City Council has directed heritage planning staff to undertake a heritage conservation district study for the area of Island Park Drive, within which this property is located; and
WHEREAS advancing this report to the June 10, 2026 meeting of Council following consideration by Built Heritage Committee ensures the appropriate protections are in place at the earliest opportunity.
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that Built Heritage Committee waive the rules of procedure to consider the designation of 575 Island Park Drive at the June 9, 2026 Built Heritage Committee meeting; and
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that Report ACS2026-PDB-RHU-0041 rise to the June 10, 2026 meeting of Council for consideration.
